name: Technical University of Darmstadt
description: TU Darmstadt is a public technical university in Darmstadt, Hesse, with about 24,000 students. It is best known for engineering, computer science and the natural sciences.
whyIncluded: TU Darmstadt is among the 10 universities in Germany most chosen by international students (about 7,800 international students, 32% of 24,465, per a 2026 aggregator figure), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

programmes.name: Informatik B.Sc.
programmes.summary: No tuition, including for international students. The figure is only the compulsory semester contribution, which includes a Germany-wide transport ticket and a 50 euro administration fee. Taught in German.
programmes.notes: No tuition fees: Hesse charges no general tuition fees, including for non-EU students, and TU Darmstadt's fee page lists only the semester contribution. Compulsory fees = semester contribution for regular (degree-seeking) students, winter semester 2026/27, EUR 402.68 x2 (early-payment rate; EUR 30 more if paid late): Deutschlandsemesterticket 226.80 + Studierendenwerk 103.00 + student council/AStA 16.00 + hardship fund 0.40 + Call-a-Bike 2.98 + theatre 0.75 + museum 0.10 + student union membership 0.40 + legal protection insurance 2.00 + Studierendenwerk building 0.25 = 352.68, plus the Hesse administration fee (Verwaltungskostenbeitrag) 50.00; exchange students pay 352.68. History from TU Darmstadt's 'Liste der Semesterbeitraege der letzten Jahre' PDF (regular students, incl. administration fee 50): winter 2024/25 EUR 338.18 (incl. ticket 176.40, Studierendenwerk 93) -> 676.36; winter 2025/26 EUR 381.18 (ticket 208.80, Studierendenwerk 103) -> 762.36; summer terms not used. Language of instruction: German. Programme name and language from TU Darmstadt's bachelor's overview (tu-darmstadt.de/studieren/studieninteressierte/studienangebot_studiengaenge/bachelor_studiengaenge_4/), which lists every bachelor's as German-taught and says bachelor's 'typically' take six semesters; the per-programme standard period was not checked.
